review_comments.body:
`ruff format --check` wants this on one line, and CI runs that check. It fits within the line length:

```suggestion
@click.option("--db", type=int, help="Redis database number (env: REDIS_DB, default 0)")
```

Consider also setting `db`, `cluster_mode` and `ssl_cert_reqs` here and asserting they survive, so this test covers every option the fix touches:

```python
monkeypatch.setitem(cfg.REDIS_CFG, "db", 3)
monkeypatch.setitem(cfg.REDIS_CFG, "cluster_mode", True)
monkeypatch.setitem(cfg.REDIS_CFG, "ssl_cert_reqs", "none")
```
